teaching_note: Establish why systems thinking is needed and frame a learning challenge
Define dynamic behavior with reference modes, evidence, and time horizons
Build causal-loop diagrams as testable feedback hypotheses
Use archetypes and mental models to generate competing intervention hypotheses
Translate feedback hypotheses into stocks, flows, units, and accumulation equations
Implement and verify the first executable Vensim model
Explain delays, nonlinearities, oscillation, overshoot, and changing loop dominance
Test structure and behavior, use data responsibly, and make a credibility claim
Apply feedback modeling to supply management and inventory dynamics
Apply systems thinking to healthcare and human-service delivery
Design robust policy portfolios and identify leverage, resistance, and unintended consequences
Defend the integrated systems insight, model use, and learning strategy
